title: Hardstone Biker Nocturne
coreRelationships: The vertical flag pole bisects the upper half of the frame, creating a strong anchor.
The biker's back is turned to the viewer, emphasizing the detailed leather vest and patches.
The motorcycle's chrome and red engine components provide a sharp technical contrast to the organic grass and soft sky.
The low horizon line makes the subjects appear monumental against the vast atmosphere.
